items.title: exportProductsStep
items.description: This step exports products to a CSV file based on the provided filters.

items.title: generateProductCsvStep
items.description:
This step generates a CSV file that exports products. The CSV
file is created and stored using the registered [File Module Provider](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/infrastructure-modules/file).

items.title: getAllProductsStep
items.description: This step retrieves all products matching a set of filters.

items.title: getVariantAvailabilityStep
items.description: This step computes the inventory availability for a list of variants in a given sales channel.

items.title: normalizeCsvToChunksStep
items.description:
This step parses a CSV file holding products to import, returning the chunks
to be processed. Each chunk is written to a file using the file provider.

items.title: normalizeCsvStep
items.description:
This step parses a CSV file holding products to import, returning the products as
objects that can be imported.

items.title: parseProductCsvStep
items.description:
This step parses a CSV file holding products to import, returning the products as
objects that can be imported.

items.title: processImportChunksStep
items.description:
This step parses a CSV file holding products to import, returning the products as
objects that can be imported.

items.title: processProductOptionsForImportStep
items.description:
This step processes products with options during import. It performs the following actions:

1. Creates product options.
2. Transforms `product.options` in the input to `product.option_ids`.
3. Transforms variant options from `{title: value}` to `{optionId: value}`.

items.title: removeImageFromVariantsStep
items.description: This step removes an image from one or more product variants.

items.title: removeImagesFromVariantStep
items.description: This step removes one or more images from a product variant.

items.title: removeProductOptionsFromProductStep
items.description: This step removes product options from products.

items.title: updateCollectionsStep
items.description: This step updates collections matching the specified filters.

items.title: updateProductOptionValuesOnProductStep
items.description: This step updates product option values linked to products.

items.title: updateProductOptionValuesStep
items.description: This step updates a product option value.

items.title: updateProductOptionsStep
items.description: This step updates product options matching the specified filters.

items.title: updateProductTagsStep
items.description: This step updates product tags matching the specified filters.

items.title: updateProductTypesStep
items.description: This step updates product types matching the specified filters.

items.title: updateProductVariantsStep
items.description: This step updates one or more product variants.

items.title: updateProductsStep
items.description: This step updates one or more products.

items.title: waitConfirmationProductImportStep
items.description:
This step waits until a product import is confirmed. It's useful before executing the
[batchProductsWorkflow](/references/core_flows/Product/Workflows_Product/functions/core_flows.Product.Workflows_Product.batchProductsWorkflow).

This step is asynchronous and will make the workflow using it a [Long-Running Workflow](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/long-running-workflow).
